**In one line**: Georgia utility regulators approved a power-supply agreement between Georgia Power and OpenAI for a data center.

### Key points
- According to local broadcaster WSB-TV, utility officials signed off on the Georgia Power–OpenAI data center agreement.
- Georgia Power, one of the largest utilities in the U.S. Southeast, is reported to supply electricity to an OpenAI-linked data center project.
- Specific terms such as contract size, power load, and rate conditions were not detailed in the report.

### Why it matters
As AI training and inference demand surges, securing power for data centers has become a core bottleneck. Regulatory approval highlights how large-scale AI infrastructure is now tied directly to regional grids and utility rate policy.
